name: Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data
description: First comprehensive UAE federal data-protection statute, in force January 2022. GDPR-influenced consent/rights/cross-border-transfer rules. Excludes DIFC and ADGM (which have their own separate free-zone data protection regimes) and national-security government data.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by UAE Legislation (official federal legislation portal) (uaelegislation.gov.ae) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within UAE Legislation (official federal legislation portal) (uaelegislation.gov.ae).
